questions.question: In Lystra, Paul called out for a man who had never walked to stand up. What did the man do?

answers.text: Jumped up and began to walk
Stood but could not take a step
Asked Paul to pray for him first

questions.question: After Paul healed a man in Lystra, the crowds thought Paul and Barnabas were gods. What did they call Barnabas?
When disciples gathered around Paul after he was stoned and dragged out of Lystra, what did he do?

answers.text: Got up and went back into the city
Asked them to carry him to Derbe
Rested outside the city for a week

questions.question: When Paul and Barnabas returned to Antioch, they told the church God had opened the door of faith to whom?
